verdict.line: You lose if you let Darius stack Hemorrhage and fight into E (Apprehend) range before level 6; you win by farming through it into a Trinity Force spike he can't answer.

brief.thesis: Darius's Hemorrhage stacks and Apprehend pull create a bleed-and-execute pattern that outpaces Camille's trades until she has Trinity Force and Hookshot online. The 51% Camille win rate over 641 games confirms this is winnable, but only by refusing the fights Darius wants and taking the ones on your terms after level 6.

theirWindow.when: E is up and you're in his pull radius
theirWindow.what: Darius wants to land Apprehend to pull you in, stack five Hemorrhage bleeds, and follow with R (Noxian Guillotine) reset potential. Do not fight or even farm the melee-range casters/cannon minion when his E is off cooldown — back off a step and let the wave push instead.

yourWindow.when: his E is on cooldown, post-6 with Hookshot up
yourWindow.what: This is your only clean engage window. Use W (Hookshot) to either pull him for a stacked auto-Q trade or hook a minion to disengage after he's forced to use E on a push. Trade with Q (Precision Protocol) resets and disengage with E (Phase Overdrive) before he can reposition.

powerCurve.note: Darius's range and bleed win short trades
Hookshot and Ultimate open real skirmishes
Trinity Force burst outscales his bleed damage
Ravenous Hydra teamfight presence takes over

start.why: Doran's Blade is the higher-pick-rate (68.2%) and slightly higher-win-rate (50.4% over 524 games) start; the extra sustain and auto damage help you contest CS through Darius's bleed poke.

boots.why: Plated Steelcaps has both the higher pick rate (79.8%) and win rate (51.6% over 529 games) into Darius's auto-attack-and-bleed trade pattern, cutting down the sustained physical damage from his stacks.

core.why: The Trinity Force > Ravenous Hydra > Death's Dance path is the strongest recorded line (62.4% over 157 games) and gives Camille the burst/mobility spike that finally out-trades Darius's bleed.
Adds the wave-clear and sustained damage needed to survive extended skirmishes where Darius is trying to stack five bleeds on you.
Damage-over-time healing directly counters Darius's Hemorrhage ticks and Guillotine execute threat, and this is the highest win-rate finisher of the three recorded paths.

situational.when: the game goes long and you're ability-cooldown reliant to keep resetting Q (Precision Protocol) in extended fights
Darius is snowballing and you need the shield/tenacity to survive his all-in and Guillotine execute
you're behind on gold and need cheaper wave clear to reset off cannon waves without contesting him in melee

runes.keystoneWhy: Grasp is the higher-performing keystone here (51.5% over the 23.1% pick-rate page vs. 44.1% for the Precision-secondary page); the free trade proc and max-health scaling let you poke Darius without initiating into his Apprehend range.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the second most-picked combo (13.9% pick) and lets you reset off deep waves after being forced back by Darius's early pressure, while still holding Flash to dodge Apprehend or Guillotine range. Flash+Ignite (75.8% pick, 50.8% win rate) is the higher-pick alternative if you want kill pressure once you hit your level 6-8 skirmish window instead.

playing.title: Never stand in Apprehend range
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to stay out of E (Apprehend) pull range at all times; a single hit hands Darius a free stack-and-bleed combo you cannot win before level 6.

playing.title: Farm through levels 1-5, don't trade
playing.detail: Darius wins short trades on raw stats and bleed stacking through level 5; use Q (Precision Protocol) only to last-hit from range, not to initiate.

playing.title: Track his Hemorrhage stack count
playing.detail: Five stacks trigger bonus true damage on his next auto; if you see him stacking on minions near you, disengage before he can flip that damage onto you.

playing.title: Hookshot minions to reset space
playing.detail: Use W (Hookshot) on a minion to yank yourself out of range when he closes with E, rather than saving it purely as an engage tool pre-6.

playing.title: Look for post-6 skirmishes only when his E is down
playing.detail: Bait his Apprehend onto a minion or dodge it, then combo Hookshot-onto-him into R (Ultimate) and Q resets while he has no pull for the return trade.

playing.title: Respect his Guillotine execute threshold
playing.detail: Below roughly 30% HP you are in R (Noxian Guillotine) execute range; disengage with E (Phase Overdrive) rather than trying to fight it out.

playing.title: Play for the Trinity Force spike
playing.detail: Your win condition is reaching Trinity Force (first core item, 62.4% win rate in that build path) intact; prioritize surviving lane over contesting kills until then.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the trade-pattern and timing analysis is my own reading of Camille's and Darius's kits and is not itself measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not stand in range of Darius’s (E) pull! Try to focus on farming lane as Camille has better potential late game than Darius.
